# Copilot Skills

This directory contains specialized skills for AI coding agents working on this video conference project.

## Available Skills

### Project Setup (`project-setup.md`)
Build commands, mobile deployment, environment variables, and file structure overview.

**Use when:** Setting up the development environment or understanding project organization.

### Streaming (`streaming.md`)
WebTransport connection patterns, bidirectional/unidirectional streams, and binary protocol details.

**Use when:** Working with real-time video/audio streaming or modifying stream protocols.

### Authentication (`authentication.md`)
Token management, authentication checks, Phoenix channel auth, and login flow patterns.

**Use when:** Implementing authentication features or debugging auth issues.

## Adding New Skills

1. Create a new markdown file in this directory
2. Use clear code examples with comments
3. Focus on project-specific patterns that differ from common practices
4. Link to existing documentation instead of duplicating it
